additional_info.subject: 0402445 - ID0402445-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / P3 170000340] OCPP disconnected CRM:00312000044
additional_info.body:
Hey Liz,
Hope you are doing well.
We received a technical support request, whereby the customer is reporting the charger is not online on OCPP.
Our global team have logged into the router remotely and identified that the SIM card appears not inserted.
Do you know if you have any spare RUT240 available in stock [Part number 8EM5903-0AA01-3AA8]?
We've been advised from the global team to attend site to investigate the SIM card, potentially replace with another SIM card and if this doesnt resolve it, replace the router XF4.
The alternative router will need to be configured with the SiCharge D Companion tool, which we will send through once the technician is confirmed and estimate ~ 2 hours of site work.
Hey Kiel,
Would you be able to raise a PO for Liz based on the above hours (+ travel time) against ID 299?
I believe we can agree that based on what the fault is, If the router needs to be replaced, then the invoice may be raised against Siemens, else we would believe it will be invoiced to the customer.
Up until now, they have tried to reboot the charger, but it has still not recovered.
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility
